create_json_dataset: create a JsonDataset instance from a registered COCO json dataset name in the dataset catalog
get_roidb_with_gt: get an roidb with ground truth annotations and optional proposal filtering from a JsonDataset
add_proposals_to_roidb: add proposal boxes from a pickle file to an existing roidb with crowd filtering support
merge_proposal_boxes: merge proposal boxes into an roidb and compute overlaps with ground truth boxes
filter_crowd_proposals: filter proposals that overlap crowd regions above a threshold and mark them as excluded
